pain.heading: Three things cost you return. Rarely said out loud.
pain.subheading: Nobody wants to decide on half a picture. It happens on every deal anyway.
pain.title_1: You decide on what you are shown.
pain.body_1: Customer concentration. Whether AI can take over the target's core business. Neither is in the IM. It surfaces after signing.
pain.feeling_1: That nagging feeling in an IC decision is usually right. There is more than you can see.
pain.title_2: Every acquisition starts from zero again.
pain.body_2: What the last deal taught you leaves with the dealmaker. Or lands in a folder nobody opens.
pain.feeling_2: You know you worked this out before. You just cannot find where.
pain.title_3: Portfolio problems are visible months earlier.
pain.body_3: Lagging numbers play out for quarters before the annual report confirms them. Without regular measurement you see it too late.
pain.feeling_3: The annual report confirms what you suspected three quarters ago.

over.meta_description: Founder of Agentic Mindshift. Six years of acquisition finance and financial restructuring in the European mid-market.

hero.subtext: Six years on the financing and restructuring side of European deals. I use that experience to show PE partners where their return leaks away, before the annual figures confirm it.

over.answer_first: Agentic Mindshift was founded by Wouter Dijkman, with six years of acquisition finance and financial restructuring at Rabobank, ING and Alter Domus. The firm advises European mid-market PE funds and M&A firms on AI strategy, AI advisory and implementation, out of deal practice itself.

bio.quote: I have seen deals that added up on paper and still stalled. Nobody dared question the uncomfortable assumption out loud. That is what I work on. With better questions, not more data.
bio.para1: Three years of financial restructuring, three years of acquisition finance. Both sides of the European mid-market. That combination shows exactly where assumptions fail, and where monthly reporting hides setbacks instead of flagging them.
bio.para2_prefix: Agentic Mindshift started in October 2025. AI for Business at Nyenrode followed in November 2025. Running since 2026:
bio.para2_suffix: : an AI platform with which deal teams put their DD process, monthly reporting and judgement on a fixed footing.
bio.para3: I keep this deliberately selective: a handful of partners at a time, so every engagement gets the attention a deal deserves.

privacy.meta_description: Privacy statement of Agentic Mindshift. GDPR-compliant, transparent and limited in data collection.
privacy.heading: Privacy Statement
privacy.intro: This privacy statement explains what personal data Agentic Mindshift collects, for what purpose, on what legal basis, how long it is retained and what rights you have. The policy is aligned with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
privacy.s1_body: The controller for processing is Agentic Mindshift, established in the Netherlands. Contact person: Wouter Dijkman, reachable at wouter@agenticmindshift.nl.
privacy.s2_body: This site has no forms. We only collect data you send us yourself: the content of your email, and the name, email address and appointment details you provide when you book a call through our scheduling link. In addition we process technical data such as IP address and user agent in standard hosting logs.
privacy.s3_li1: Scheduling and holding an introductory call — performance of a contract.
privacy.s3_li2: Answering your email and following up on it — legitimate interest.
privacy.s3_li3: Securing the website and keeping it available — legitimate interest.
privacy.s4_body: We keep correspondence and appointment details for a maximum of 24 months after the last contact, unless you ask us to delete them sooner. Hosting logs are deleted after thirty days. Data belonging to an ongoing engagement is kept for as long as statutory retention periods require.
privacy.s5_body: We use a limited number of processors: Plausible Analytics (EU) for visitor statistics, Cal.com for scheduling calls, a European hosting provider for the website and our e-mail provider for correspondence. A data processing agreement is in place with each processor.
privacy.s6_body: By default your data is stored and processed within the European Union. Should transfer outside the EU occur, it takes place exclusively on the basis of the standard contractual clauses of the European Commission.
privacy.s7_body: You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and objection. A request can be directed to wouter@agenticmindshift.nl. You may also lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority.
privacy.s8_body: The website sets no cookies. Visits are counted with Plausible Analytics: no cookie, no fingerprint, no profile across websites. What is recorded is page, referring site, country and device type. Nothing is placed on your device for that count. That is why there is no cookie banner on this site. If you book a call through our scheduling link, that provider’s terms apply on their page.
privacy.s9_body: We reserve the right to amend this statement. The most current version is always on this page.

voorwaarden.meta_description: Terms and conditions for engagements and use of the Agentic Mindshift website.
voorwaarden.heading: Terms and Conditions
voorwaarden.s1_body: In these terms, "Agentic Mindshift" means the sole proprietorship of Wouter Dijkman, established in the Netherlands. "Client" means the natural or legal person who commissions work or uses the website.
voorwaarden.s2_body: These terms apply to all use of the website agenticmindshift.nl and to all engagements in which Agentic Mindshift acts as contractor. Deviations apply only if agreed in writing.
voorwaarden.s3_body: Engagements are performed as a best-efforts obligation, unless expressly agreed otherwise. The content of advice, reports and sparring sessions does not constitute investment or financial advice within the meaning of the Dutch Financial Supervision Act.
voorwaarden.s4_body: Rates are set out in writing per engagement in the engagement confirmation and are exclusive of VAT unless stated otherwise. Invoicing is monthly in advance for retainer engagements and on delivery for projects. Payment term: thirty days net.
voorwaarden.s5_body: Retainer engagements have a minimum duration of three months and are thereafter terminable monthly with a notice period of one month. Single sparring sessions may be rescheduled or cancelled without charge up to three working days before the agreed date. Workshops and training are non-cancellable within ten working days before the agreed date.
voorwaarden.s6_body: The liability of Agentic Mindshift is limited to the invoice amount of the engagement in question over a period of a maximum of three months, with a maximum of 25,000 euro. Liability for indirect damage, consequential loss, loss of profit or missed IRR is excluded.
voorwaarden.s7_body: All information shared in the context of an engagement or sparring session is treated as confidential. This applies without end date. Aggregated, non-identifiable data may be used to improve the reference levels.
voorwaarden.s8_body: Reports, frameworks and analyses remain the intellectual property of Agentic Mindshift, unless agreed otherwise. The client receives a non-transferable right of use for internal purposes.
voorwaarden.s9_body: These terms and all engagements are governed by Dutch law. Disputes are submitted to the competent court in the district of establishment.
